facts.title: HeroUI v3 (Previously NextUI) - Beautiful by default, customizable by design.
facts.description: Beautiful, accessible React UI components built on React Aria and Tailwind CSS v4. The modern alternative to MUI, Chakra UI, and shadcn/ui for building production-ready applications.

research.name: HeroUI
research.note: React component library, formerly NextUI, built on React Aria and Tailwind CSS v4, with a React Native sibling and a paid Pro tier.
unverified: nextui.org redirects to heroui.com. The component source is public in the Apache-2.0 repository heroui-inc/heroui (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
